This 14K gold mariner bracelet, also called an anchor chain bracelet, has oval links crossed by a center bar: the nautical pattern of a ship's anchor chain, made to sit on the wrist.
The links are semi-hollow, a thick wall of 14K gold around a small hollow core, so even the 10.15mm size stays comfortable all day. Pair it with the mariner link necklace for a matching set. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.
Details
• Metal: 14K gold (585), never plated or filled
• Links: semi-hollow oval mariner (anchor) links
• Small: 5.70mm (0.22") wide, about 4.75 g at 7"
• Medium: 7.15mm (0.28") wide, about 5.15 g at 7"
• Large: 8.50mm (0.33") wide, about 6.15 g at 7"
• X-Large: 10.15mm (0.40") wide, about 8.50 g at 7"
• Clasp: lobster claw
• Lengths: 5.5", 6", 6.5", 7", 7.5" or 8"
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping and free returns within 30 days.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.

Evenly spaced, polished spheres make this 14K gold ball chain necklace simple and timeless. Also known as a sphere link chain or bead chain, it moves smoothly and catches light at every turn.
Choose 1mm, 1.2mm or 1.5mm beads to wear alone or layered. The same chain comes as a ball chain bracelet .
Details
• Metal: solid 14K gold (585)
• Bead sizes: 1mm, 1.20mm or 1.50mm
• Weight at 18": 1mm 2 g, 1.20mm 2.50 g, 1.50mm 3.60 g
• Clasp: lobster claw
• Lengths: 14", 16", 18", 20" or 22"
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• Solid 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping and free returns within 30 days.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.

Details
• Metal: solid 14K gold (585), stamped 14K / 585
• Center stone: lab-grown ruby
• Accents: white cubic zirconia
• Weight: about 1.40 g
• Ring sizes: US 4 to 12, including half sizes
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• Solid 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping and free returns within 30 days.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.

The hamsa hand, also called the Hand of Fatima, is a symbol of protection and good luck. This 14K gold hamsa necklace places a deep blue lab-grown sapphire at its center, framed by CZ accents.
The hamsa hand necklace is about 12mm by 9mm, meaningful and easy to wear every day. Both the hamsa and the evil eye are worn for protection; read what the evil eye symbol means .
Details
• Metal: solid 14K gold (585)
• Center stone: lab-grown sapphire
• Accents: cubic zirconia
• Pendant size: about 12mm x 9mm
• Chain: 1mm 14K gold chain
• Weight: about 1.90 g with an 18" chain
• Length: pendant only, or on a 14", 16", 18", 20" or 22" chain
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• Solid 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping and free returns within 30 days.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.

The mariner chain, also called an anchor chain, takes its pattern from the chains used on ships: oval links, each crossed by a center bar. Our 14K gold mariner necklace has puffed, rounded links polished to a mirror shine.
It is semi-hollow, each link a thick wall of 14K gold around a small hollow core, so even the wider sizes feel substantial without weighing you down. Choose from four widths and lengths from 14" to 24"; the mariner link bracelet matches it. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.
Details
• Metal: 14K gold (585), never plated or filled
• Links: semi-hollow oval mariner (anchor) links
• Small: 5.70mm (0.22") wide, about 12.50 g at 18"
• Medium: 7.15mm (0.28") wide, about 14 g at 18"
• Large: 8.50mm (0.33") wide, about 16 g at 18"
• X-Large: 10.15mm (0.40") wide, about 22.20 g at 18"
• Clasp: lobster claw
• Lengths: 14", 16", 18", 20", 22" or 24"
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping and free returns within 30 days.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.

This gold belcher chain has round, full solid links with a polished diamond-cut finish that sparkles as it moves. It is our full solid rolo chain: about twice the weight of our semi-hollow rolo chain necklace and rolo bracelet at a similar width.
Choose 2mm, 2.8mm or 3.2mm, as a bracelet from 5.5" to 9" or a necklace from 14" to 30". It is a strong base for a pendant or a clean chain on its own. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.
Details
• Metal: solid 14K gold (585), full solid links
• Widths: 2mm, 2.80mm or 3.20mm
• Weight at 18": 2mm 5.65 g, 2.80mm 6.20 g, 3.20mm 10 g
• Clasp: lobster claw
• Lengths: 5.5" to 9" (bracelet), 14" to 30" (necklace)
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• Solid 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping and free returns within 30 days.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.

This gold belcher chain has round, full solid links with a polished diamond-cut finish that sparkles as it moves. It is our full solid rolo chain: about twice the weight of our semi-hollow rolo chain necklace and rolo bracelet at a similar width.
Choose 2mm, 2.8mm or 3.2mm, as a bracelet from 5.5" to 9" or a necklace from 14" to 30". It is a strong base for a pendant or a clean chain on its own. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.
Details
• Metal: solid 14K gold (585), full solid links
• Widths: 2mm, 2.80mm or 3.20mm
• Weight at 18": 2mm 5.65 g, 2.80mm 6.20 g, 3.20mm 10 g
• Clasp: lobster claw
• Lengths: 5.5" to 9" (bracelet), 14" to 30" (necklace)
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• Solid 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping and free returns within 30 days.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.

This 14K gold Cuban link bracelet has the same flat, tightly interlocking curb links as our Miami Cuban link chain , sized for the wrist. It is a unisex bracelet: wear the 3mm alone every day, or stack widths up to the 6mm.
Like the chain, it is semi-hollow: each link is a thick wall of 14K gold around a small hollow core, so it sits comfortably and stays lighter than a fully solid bracelet of the same width. Lengths run from 5.5" to 9" in half-inch steps. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.
Details
• Metal: 14K gold (585), never plated or filled
• Links: semi-hollow Cuban curb links
• X-Small: 3mm (0.12") wide, about 2.50 g at 7.5"
• Small: 3.70mm (0.15") wide, about 3.50 g at 7.5"
• Medium: 4.40mm (0.17") wide, about 5 g at 7.5"
• Large: 5.60mm (0.22") wide, about 7 g at 7.5"
• X-Large: 6mm (0.24") wide, about 9 g at 7.5"
• Clasp: lobster
• Lengths: 5.5" to 9"
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.

This 14K gold Cuban link bracelet has the same flat, tightly interlocking curb links as our Miami Cuban link chain , sized for the wrist. It is a unisex bracelet: wear the 3mm alone every day, or stack widths up to the 6mm.

This 14K gold Cuban link bracelet has the same flat, tightly interlocking curb links as our Miami Cuban link chain , sized for the wrist. It is a unisex bracelet: wear the 3mm alone every day, or stack widths up to the 6mm.

Lengths run from 5.5" to 9" in half-inch steps. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.

• X-Small: 3mm (0.12") wide, about 2.50 g at 7.5"

• X-Large: 6mm (0.24") wide, about 9 g at 7.5"
• Clasp: lobster
• Lengths: 5.5" to 9"

Why Heon

This 14K gold Cuban link bracelet has the same flat, tightly interlocking curb links as our Miami Cuban link chain , sized for the wrist. It is a unisex bracelet: wear the 3mm alone every day, or stack widths up to the 6mm.
Like the chain, it is semi-hollow: each link is a thick wall of 14K gold around a small hollow core, so it sits comfortably and stays lighter than a fully solid bracelet of the same width. Lengths run from 5.5" to 9" in half-inch steps. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.

• X-Small: 3mm (0.12") wide, about 2.50 g at 7.5"

• Medium: 4.40mm (0.17") wide, about 5 g at 7.5"
• Large: 5.60mm (0.22") wide, about 7 g at 7.5"

• Clasp: lobster
• Lengths: 5.5" to 9"
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.

This 14K gold Cuban link bracelet has the same flat, tightly interlocking curb links as our Miami Cuban link chain , sized for the wrist. It is a unisex bracelet: wear the 3mm alone every day, or stack widths up to the 6mm.

This 14K gold Cuban link bracelet has the same flat, tightly interlocking curb links as our Miami Cuban link chain , sized for the wrist. It is a unisex bracelet: wear the 3mm alone every day, or stack widths up to the 6mm.
Like the chain, it is semi-hollow: each link is a thick wall of 14K gold around a small hollow core, so it sits comfortably and stays lighter than a fully solid bracelet of the same width. Lengths run from 5.5" to 9" in half-inch steps. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.

• Metal: 14K gold (585), never plated or filled
• Links: semi-hollow Cuban curb links
• X-Small: 3mm (0.12") wide, about 2.50 g at 7.5"
• Small: 3.70mm (0.15") wide, about 3.50 g at 7.5"
• Medium: 4.40mm (0.17") wide, about 5 g at 7.5"
• Large: 5.60mm (0.22") wide, about 7 g at 7.5"
• X-Large: 6mm (0.24") wide, about 9 g at 7.5"
• Clasp: lobster
• Lengths: 5.5" to 9"
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.

This 14K gold Cuban link bracelet has the same flat, tightly interlocking curb links as our Miami Cuban link chain , sized for the wrist. It is a unisex bracelet: wear the 3mm alone every day, or stack widths up to the 6mm.

This 14K gold Cuban link bracelet has the same flat, tightly interlocking curb links as our Miami Cuban link chain , sized for the wrist. It is a unisex bracelet: wear the 3mm alone every day, or stack widths up to the 6mm.
Like the chain, it is semi-hollow: each link is a thick wall of 14K gold around a small hollow core, so it sits comfortably and stays lighter than a fully solid bracelet of the same width. Lengths run from 5.5" to 9" in half-inch steps. Curious how semi-hollow gold compares with solid? Our guide to solid vs. semi-hollow gold explains the difference.
Details
• Metal: 14K gold (585), never plated or filled
• Links: semi-hollow Cuban curb links
• X-Small: 3mm (0.12") wide, about 2.50 g at 7.5"
• Small: 3.70mm (0.15") wide, about 3.50 g at 7.5"
• Medium: 4.40mm (0.17") wide, about 5 g at 7.5"
• Large: 5.60mm (0.22") wide, about 7 g at 7.5"
• X-Large: 6mm (0.24") wide, about 9 g at 7.5"
• Clasp: lobster
• Lengths: 5.5" to 9"
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping and free returns within 30 days.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.
